extra.final_summary:
Total revenue by region for Electronics: South $10,540, East $7,580, North $3,750, West $1,800 (12 rows used).

Problems found and fixed:
1. Region label variants (rows 11, 17, 31, 44, 51, 66): " South", "North ", "east", "north", "west" normalized to the allowed labels South/North/East/West — otherwise region totals would have been split.
2. Revenue formula violations (rows 10, 19, 61): Revenue did not equal Quantity * Price (e.g. row 10 had 2400 instead of 240); recomputed per the rules file.
3. Negative quantities (rows 5, 14, 65): Quantity must be ≥ 1 per rules; these impossible rows (negative revenue) were excluded. None were Electronics.

Caveats: 3 rows (36, 40, 49) have missing Region and were left unfilled (the rules file gives no basis for guessing); one of them (row 36, an Electronics laptop sale of $5,400) is not included in any region total above. No duplicate rows found.
